svg.title: Container diagram: Wishem
svg.desc: Wishem has nine containers. The designer starts the three processes and the Godot runner, edits the model folder and the product model folder, and looks at the two pages. The page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the workbench process. The workbench process reads, watches, and writes the two folders. The PixiJS page connects the same way to the PixiJS process. The Godot runner starts the Godot application in Docker and carries the link of the application over TCP to the Godot process.
